```sql
-- Find the geometry of Kamjong
WITH kamjong AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM divisions_area
    WHERE id = '48a8eacf-f240-44ba-95f8-4734abc5e1c9'
)

-- Find all counties that touch Kamjong
SELECT
    d.id,
    d.names."primary" AS name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry
FROM divisions_area d
JOIN kamjong k
  ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, k.geometry)
WHERE d.subtype = 'county'
  AND d.id <> '48a8eacf-f240-44ba-95f8-4734abc5e1c9';
```

```sql
    SELECT geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE id = '3d3a7382-1e7c-47d6-a677-f589260ca729'   -- Bhind
)

-- Find all states that touch Bhind
SELECT
    d.id,
    d.names."primary" AS name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divations_area') AS d

WHERE d.subtype = 'state';
```
